headline: Colonials Gain in Weathered Expanse; Two Mooring Works Change Hands
war_summary: The lines about Weathered Expanse and Mooring County have shifted since the last edition. In the Expanse the Colonials now hold five of nine works and the Wardens one, with three lying unclaimed, where six stood empty at the morning filing; ninety events were logged there in the day and nine in the past two hours, and reports were still arriving at the hour of this dispatch, on a twenty-four-hour ledger of 7,816 Colonial and 10,209 Warden casualties. In Mooring County the Colonials have retaken two works from the Wardens, who now stand at ten against two, with forty-eight events counted on the day and six within two hours. Callahan's Passage remains under fire, 807 Colonial and 866 Warden casualties in the latest hour, its nine-to-one Warden holding otherwise unchanged. Nevish Line, six Warden works to two Colonial, has gone silent since before dawn, and Kuura Strand and Fisherman's Row, which churned yesterday, have stayed quiet some twenty hours. Across 436 works the Colonials hold 310, the Wardens 121, and five lie unclaimed; thirty-four towns remain the mark for victory.
